postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && cd launcher && npm install && npm run db:reset && npm run db:seed

remoteEnv.//: Option A — Claude Code talks Anthropic Messages directly to Ollama Cloud. ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (your Ollama Cloud API key from ollama.com/settings/keys) is injected from a GitHub Codespaces Secret — NOT committed here.
